io.milvus.bulkwriter.restful

Class BulkImportUtils

  • java.lang.Object
    • io.milvus.bulkwriter.restful.BaseRestful
      • io.milvus.bulkwriter.restful.BulkImportUtils

  • public class BulkImportUtils
extends BaseRestful
    REST helper for driving bulk-import jobs on the Milvus vector database.

    Provides methods to create, monitor, list, commit, and abort bulk-import jobs through the Milvus /v2/vectordb/jobs/import REST API. The bulk writer uses these endpoints to submit the uploaded data files for import and to commit the job once all chunks have been flushed.
